prompt: A cohesive set of nine minimal icons arranged in a precise three by three grid with equal spacing and identical icon sizes: a calculator, a cube drawn in isometric wireframe, a stack of three timber boards, three staggered horizontal timeline bars, a floor plan with one door swing, a document with a dollar sign, a house, a builder's hard hat, and two people side by side. Monoline style with one uniform thin stroke weight, rounded line caps and joins, consistent square-grid proportions, generous negative space, no fills. Elegant, refined and technical, like premium signage in a high-end lounge. Strictly one color: every stroke in the locked primary tone on the locked background. Flat vector design, clean lines, no shadows, no texture, no text.
